subject.title: fix(skills): coding-agent completion works with SecretRef auth

question: Should bundled coding-agent workers be permanently restricted to producing terminal results while the authenticated parent exclusively owns completion and failure delivery?
rationale: The patch changes the long-term trust and lifecycle boundary for all supported external coding workers; source-level wording alone cannot determine whether worker-originated delivery remains a supported product contract in any restricted-sandbox flow.

options.title: Confirm parent-owned delivery
options.body: Approve the parent as the sole notification owner, then require live authenticated success and failure proof before merge.

options.title: Retain worker delivery support
options.body: Keep a supported worker-originated path and define a narrowly scoped credential or capability mechanism that does not expose the parent Gateway secret.

options.title: Split the contract decision
options.body: Land no behavior change yet and open a maintainer-owned design discussion covering worker lifecycle, delivery ownership, and supported sandbox modes.

recommendation.title: Confirm parent-owned delivery
recommendation.body: Approve the parent as the sole notification owner, then require live authenticated success and failure proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Gateway SecretRef work documents the existing fail-closed credential boundary most directly implicated by the proposed routing change.
